summary: Successfully implemented custom ReadOnlyView store implementation for MeteredWindowStore (KAFKA-20497). Added a readOnly(IsolationLevel) method to MeteredWindowStore that returns a MeteredReadOnlyWindowStore inner class. The MeteredReadOnlyWindowStore implements ReadOnlyWindowStore<K, V> and wraps the result of wrapped().readOnly(isolationLevel), applying serdes for key/value conversion and recording metrics for all fetch operations. The implementation includes support for all read-only window store methods: fetch(K key, long timestamp), fetch(K key, Instant timeFrom, Instant timeTo), backwardFetch, fetch/backwardFetch with key ranges, all/backwardAll, fetchAll/backwardFetchAll. All 44 MeteredWindowStoreTest test cases pass, including 13 new readOnly-specific tests that verify serde application and metric recording in the read-only view.
